poll.source_locator: HMP release Sep 9, 2026: Impact Research, August 24-31; 'Dandiya leads Askar 46% to 44%'; informed ballot 49-44; generic ballot tied 46-46
poll.notes: out_of_window: field end Aug 31, one day before the window; written because no FL-22 poll with fieldwork on/after Sep 1 was found. No n, MoE, undecided or mode in the release (Wikipedia lists undecided 10 and attributes the poll to Tulchin Research; the HMP release says Impact Research and is followed here). American Bazaar (Sep 27) also reported it as Impact Research. New seat under the May 2026 Florida map; nominees Dandiya (D) and Askar (R).
